partner: DSG2 extracellular + DSC2 extracellular cadherin context
evidence_summary: DSG2/DSC2 are core desmosomal cadherins in the cardiac desmosome. Local evidence includes direct DSG2-DSC2 support and shared desmosome/keratinization Reactome context. Prior full-length DSG2-DSC2 was weak, so extracellular-only rescue is preferred.
support_sources: UniProt Q14126; UniProt Q02487; IntAct EBI-2556545/EBI-3048545; PubMed 21062920; Reactome R-HSA-6805567/R-HSA-6809371; local AF3_PILOTV2_019_DSG2_DSC2
caveat: Cadherin interactions can depend on Ca2+, glycosylation, membrane orientation, and desmosome architecture, none of which are fully modeled here.

evidence_summary: UniProt annotates DSG2 homodimer formation; homomeric cadherin adhesion is a clean DSG2-specific comparator if heterotypic DSG2-DSC2 remains weak.
support_sources: UniProt Q14126; PubMed 31845994; RCSB/PDB local DSG2 entries 5ERD/5J5J/6QNT/6QNU/6SIT/7A7D
caveat: Protein-only homodimer omits membrane and Ca2+/glycosylation state; use only with strong pairwise interface QC.

evidence_summary: PKP2 is a core desmosomal plaque protein and UniProt annotates DSG2-PKP2 interaction. This tests the intracellular plaque-facing part of DSG2 separate from extracellular adhesion.
support_sources: UniProt Q14126; UniProt Q99959; PubMed 11790773; Reactome R-HSA-6805567/R-HSA-6809371
caveat: Tail is likely flexible and phosphorylation-dependent; absence of membrane/plaque stoichiometry may reduce confidence.

evidence_summary: Full-length DSG2-DSC2 was already submitted in pilot-v2 and was not interface-usable.
caveat: Do not repeat by default; compact rescue is more informative.

partner: DSG2 cytoplasmic tail + JUP or DSP
evidence_summary: JUP/DSP are core desmosomal plaque proteins, but DSG2 direct evidence is weaker than PKP2 in local source stack and DSP/JUP jobs are covered in DSP/PKP2 packets.
support_sources: UniProt P14923; UniProt P15924; PubMed 16917092; Reactome desmosome context
caveat: Avoid duplicating noisy plaque jobs until PKP2/DSP/JUP outputs are reviewed.

evidence_summary: DSG2 interacts with CTNNB1 and affects junctional localization, but this is broader junction/EMT biology rather than first-pass cardiomyocyte desmosome classification context.
caveat: Potential sensitivity feature later, not top-3.

evidence_summary: DSG2 viral fiber interactions are real but not relevant to inherited cardiogenetic variant classification.
